Human-authored gate expectation: persona plus deploy wording should expose both agent and workflow surfaces and require no forced selection. Source raw candidate: RC-00011.
Human-authored gate expectation: explicit instructions wording should surface the instruction gate path, not downstream documentation generation. Source raw candidate: RC-00014.
Human-authored gate expectation: direct unit-test writing is downstream code generation, not a bounded workshop route object. Source raw candidate: RC-00021.
Human-authored gate expectation: direct code-writing plus explanation asks for downstream action rather than a workshop intent artifact. Source raw candidate: RC-00022.
Human-authored gate expectation: unresolved object plus deploy and notify actions should stay ambiguous rather than selecting a workflow or agent action. Source raw candidate: RC-00023.
Human-authored gate expectation: vague improvement request has no bounded target and should remain ambiguous. Source raw candidate: RC-00024.
Human-authored gate expectation: general-world history question is outside the Level 0 workshop intent gate. Source raw candidate: RC-00026.

Human-authored gate expectation: language-learning plus reminder deployment crosses domains and should not select a single workshop artifact. Source raw candidate: RC-00028.
Human-authored gate expectation: prompt-pattern authoring plus CI workflow modification should expose instruction and workflow surfaces without downstream action. Source raw candidate: RC-00030.
Human-authored gate expectation: conceptual prompt-engineering question is knowledge-seeking, not a bounded workshop intent. Source raw candidate: RC-00031.
